notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Patrol Signaler.
Patrol Signaler does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Tap Patrol Signaler using Paradise Mantle, generating {W}.
Activate Patrol Signaler's untap ability discounted by Zirda, generating a 1/1 white Kithkin Soldier token.
Repeat for infinite tokens.
